decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service builds directly on con terra's core GeoIT security and integration know-how, and its move to a dedicated page in 2024 signals growing commitment.

The open GIS application development framework is close to the firm's established mapping and app-building expertise, so it stays, although its low-profile, unchanged presence suggests it serves as a supporting platform rather than a flagship.

The identity service for GIS applications combines the firm's deep GIS knowledge with its security competence, and it gained a dedicated page and more specific positioning, showing the firm can interpret and build on the early results.

The geodata business process consulting workshop uses the firm's existing consulting and geodata knowledge at low cost and feeds customer insight back into its product development, so keeping it is sensible.
